summary: NFT Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing the appointment of Yaobin Wang as CFO, effective May 12, 2026, following the resignation of Jianguang Qian for personal reasons with no disagreement. Wang, previously CFO from July 2023 to August 2024, will receive an annual salary of $60,000. The board appointed him to fill the vacancy. No deal terms or other special-situation elements were reported. This is a routine executive succession filing with no shareholder vote, contest, or strategic catalyst — categorized as a management change event.
